    Bug 1989220 - calendar-minimonth and calendar-invitation-panel should be .inc.xhtml. r=arschmitz
    
    
    These are includes. Wrong extension makes it harder to reason in scripting.
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D265454

diff --git a/calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.xhtml b/calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.inc.xhtml
similarity index 100%
rename from calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.xhtml
rename to calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.inc.xhtml
diff --git a/calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.xhtml b/calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.inc.xhtml
similarity index 100%
rename from calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.xhtml
rename to calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.inc.xhtml

index 3b2184c86d1..4e6feb724bd 100644
--- a/mail/base/content/aboutMessage.xhtml
+++ b/mail/base/content/aboutMessage.xhtml
@@ -118,8 +118,8 @@
           <!-- notificationbox will be added here lazily. -->
         </vbox>
 
-#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.xhtml
-#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.xhtml

+#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.inc.xhtml
 
         <vbox id="calendarInvitationDisplayContainer"
               flex="1"

+++ b/mail/base/content/messenger.xhtml

       </html:template>
-#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.xhtml
-#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.xhtml
+#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-invitation-panel.inc.xhtml
+#include ../../../calendar/base/content/widgets/calendar-minidate.inc.xhtml
       <!-- Hidden browser used for printing documents without displaying them. -->
       <browser id="hiddenPrintContent"
                type="content"
